subject: Dual-course QC sweep + complaint intake (LM + A+)
description:
Dual-course constant-CI/CD QC operation (Linux Mastery + A+ Core 1). QC every element of both courses against the zero-knowledge bar + reproduce/verify each with the real engine (like LM-09). Fix issues, ship in small increments. Supervised agents: I verify every finding myself (boot engine, run gate/E2E, read diff), Nancy pre-edit + Chris pre-ship. Includes intake of operator-supplied user complaints as they arrive (triage -> assign -> verify -> ship -> close with evidence). LM known-issue class: missing-seed/false-completion (see backlog LinuxTerminal.js:1822).
[2026-07-31 14:25] ES-1150 INVESTIGATED + FOUND STALE 2026-07-31 (it is the only one of Nexus's 10 'critical' findings that reads as a live student-facing defect: 'Quiz has NO serverGrading and NO correct: fields -- grades everyone 0%'). It is NOT live. All four flagged A+ Core 1 prep quizzes (forge-aplus-core1-prep-round-1..4) declare serverGrading: true, call FirebaseAuth.callFunction('gradeQuiz', {quizId: CONFIG.moduleId}) at line 541, and their quiz_keys docs verify: 'Verification PASSED' for aplus-core1-prep-r1/r2/r3/r4. Finding is dated 2026-07-29 with status 'backlog' and predates the fix.
TWO TRAPS FOR WHOEVER RE-CHECKS THIS: (1) the quizId is CONFIG.moduleId (aplus-core1-prep-r1), NOT the filename (forge-aplus-core1-prep-round-1). Verifying by filename returns four confident 'NOT FOUND in Firestore' results that look exactly like a critical live defect. I made that error before catching it. (2) Nexus's 10 'critical' findings are ALL source:sprint -- backlog items, not code findings -- which is why the deploy gate correctly reported 'no critical/high findings'. The two figures describe different scopes and do not contradict each other.
STILL REAL from that critical list, not investigated here: QC-57 (95 quizzes client-grading across 15 tracks) and QC-60 (500 modules hub-catalog HUB-001 mismatch across 19 hubs).
